latest_release.name: PHP 8.5.12
latest_release.body:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.5.12. This is a security release fixing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP 8.5 users are strongly encouraged to update immediately.

There are no complete mitigations, updating is the only safe choice. See the [security advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5) for details.

For source downloads of PHP 8.5.12 please visit our [downloads page](https://www.php.net/downloads.php), Windows source and binaries can also be found [there](https://www.php.net/downloads.php?os=windows&version=8.5). The list of changes is recorded in the [ChangeLog](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php#8.5.12).
